messages:
maggie: quick follow-up from today
we surfaced a recurring pattern: autoscaler backlog + KV eviction spikes causing tail latency. proposing: 1) add a short triage checklist to runbook, 2) owner handoffs for runbook edits + automation, 3) a pattern-flag field on PMs so we route recurring cases to Pattern Board.
devon: +1 to checklist. add explicit step: confirm model-variant fallback is enabled before widen-ing resources.
anya: for automation tests I'll need the exact CLI checks. suggest: `redwoodctl cache stats --ns=inference --prefix=kv --json` and `redwoodctl model get-config --model=<model> --show-fallbacks`.
samir: owners/timeline proposal: devon -> runbook PR in 48h, anya -> test harness in 5 days, kevin -> pattern-board ticket + triage tag in 24h. I'll verify and close items.
kevin: add escalation SLA: oncall -> runtime lead in 20m, runtime -> platform in 40m if unresolved. after-hours SMS step included.
maggie: include a safe hotfix snippet (copy/paste): `redwoodctl cache flush --ns=inference --prefix=kv --confirm` with a DANGER note. also include sample output for `cache stats` so oncall knows expected fields (hit_rate, evictions, median_ttfb).
devon: will add sample outputs and a bold DANGER callout for flush in my PR.
ops-bot: Task INCIDENT-5012 "Runbook edits: autoscaler+kv triage + pattern-flag" created and assigned to samir, due 2026-04-10.
maggie: thanks all, owners and deadlines are set. I'll post the checklist to the incidents board and close this thread unless there are blockers.
